description: Sends ONE unpaid GET to an x402 paid URL and checks its 402 answer against the x402 spec (P1-P7): HTTP 402, a decodable PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (V2) or JSON body (V1), x402Version, resource, accepts[], amounts in atomic units, CAIP-2 networks, and scheme fields (EVM name/version, Solana feePayer). Never pays or signs. Use it before paying an unfamiliar x402 endpoint, or to check your own route.

url.description: The paid URL, http or https

name: x402_check_payment_required
title: Check an x402 402 answer (P1-P7)
